request.what: Reduce the minimum Constitutional Committee size (committeeMinSize) from 7 to 5 to improve operational resilience
deliverables: On-chain change of committeeMinSize from 7 to 5
request.deadline: Depends on enactment of a separate Plutus cost-model parameter-change action ahead of the van Rossem hard fork

claims.claim: With a 7-member committee and committeeMinSize of 7, a single resignation or term expiry would halt the Constitutional Committee and stall much of governance
Reducing the minimum to 5 improves resilience while keeping constitutional safeguards
The change does not alter the current number of committee members or imply a smaller committee is desired
The action was approved by Intersect's Civics Committee (2026-03-13) and Technical Steering Committee (2026-06-03)

summary: An Intersect-sponsored parameter change lowering the Constitutional Committee minimum from 7 to 5 to avoid a single resignation halting governance; no funds requested.
